reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Peeling Gel 120mL Special Set (Special Set: Cleanser 20mL)
reviews.text: Most peeling gels leave my skin tight, but the Dokdo gel leaves it deeply hydrated and smooth thanks to the deep sea minerals. Having the 120mL for home and the mini for travel is such a win.
reviews.zh: 大部分 peeling gel 都會令到我皮膚繃緊，但 Dokdo gel 因為有深海礦物，所以用完皮膚係深層保濕又滑。屋企用 120mL、旅行用細裝，真係完美配搭。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Peeling Gel 120mL Special Set (Special Set: Cleanser 20mL)
reviews.text: This is a gentle exfoliant. This is my first time using this product. This does help slough off dead skin. I’ve only used this a few times. So far it has not irritated my skin or broke my skin barrier.
reviews.zh: 呢隻係溫和嘅去角質產品。我係第一次用呢個產品。佢確實可以幫助清除死皮。我淨係用咗幾次。到目前為止，佢冇刺激我嘅皮膚或者破壞我嘅皮膚屏障。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Peeling Gel 120mL Special Set (Special Set: Cleanser 20mL)
reviews.text:
I'm disappointed with this line of products for the first time(
I like Dokdo line, this one is the exception, unfortunately. I haven't notice any changes after using it 2 times in a week for 2,5 months following the 'how to use'
reviews.zh: 我第一次對呢個產品系列感到失望( 我鍾意 Dokdo 系列，但呢隻係例外，可惜。跟住「使用方法」用咗 2.5 個月、每星期 2 次之後，我冇留意到有任何變化。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Peeling Gel 120mL Special Set (Special Set: Cleanser 20mL)
reviews.text: Gentle on the skin, and makes my skin feel very soft and smooth after use. My skin tends to be pretty sensitive, so I only use this about 1-2x a week. Will need to use for a longer period of time to decide whether it makes a lasting difference, so I'm not sure if I'll repurchase, but it feels like a very nice, clean product on the skin!
reviews.zh: 對皮膚溫和，用完之後皮膚感覺好軟好滑。我嘅皮膚傾向敏感，所以我一個星期大概淨係用 1-2 次。需要用耐少少時間先可以判斷佢係咪有持久效果，所以唔確定會唔會回購，但搽上皮膚感覺係一隻好正、好 clean 嘅產品！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Peeling Gel 120mL Special Set (Special Set: Cleanser 20mL)
reviews.text: This peeling gel is super gentle and doesn’t irritate my skin at all. It leaves my face feeling soft, clean, and hydrated. The mini cleanser is also a nice bonus – perfect for travel. Love the simple and calming texture!
reviews.zh: 呢隻 peeling gel 超級溫和，完全冇刺激到我嘅皮膚。用完之後塊面感覺柔軟、清爽又保濕。細裝 cleanser 係一個好好嘅 bonus——旅行用啱晒。好鍾意佢簡單又舒緩嘅質地！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Peeling Gel 120mL Special Set (Special Set: Cleanser 20mL)
reviews.text: It is incredibly gentle on the skin and can be used daily. However, if you are looking for an exfoliator to improve skin texture, this is not that product. It has never irritated my skin and I enjoy it as a step in my routine, but there are better exfoliating products out there. The additional cleanser sample is nice for travel.
reviews.zh: 佢對皮膚非常溫和，可以每日使用。不過，如果你想搵一款可以改善皮膚質地嘅去角質產品，呢個就唔係喇。我用咗從未刺激過皮膚，亦鍾意將佢加入我嘅護膚程序，但市面上有更好嘅去角質產品。附送嘅潔面試用裝旅行用就啱晒。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Peeling Gel 120mL Special Set (Special Set: Cleanser 20mL)
reviews.text: This peeling gel is incredibly gentle but super effective! It softly exfoliates without any irritation, removing dead skin cells and leaving my face feeling smooth, refreshed, and glowing. I love how my skincare absorbs better afterward. The bonus cleanser in the set is a lovely touch—perfect for travel and just as soothing and hydrating. A must-have for a polished, baby-soft complexion!
reviews.zh: 呢款去角質凝胶非常溫和但超級有效！佢溫和地去角質，完全冇刺激，可以去除死皮，令塊面感覺滑溜、煥然一新、充滿光澤。我好鍾意之後皮膚吸收護膚品更加好。套裝入面額外送嘅潔面產品好有心思——旅行用一流，同樣有舒緩同保濕功效。想要妝前肌膚細緻、嬰兒般柔滑嘅話必備！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB 1025 Dokdo Peeling Gel 120mL Special Set (Special Set: Cleanser 20mL)
reviews.text: I only use this product once a week to physically exfoliate my face, because physical exfoliation can be a bit too harsh on the skin and could potentially cause damage to the skin if done multiple times. The effect of this peeling gel leaves a pretty smooth surface or base for skincare and makeup. Applying skincare and makeup after physical exfoliation feels a lot nicer.
reviews.zh: 我每個星期只係用一次呢款產品做物理性去角質，因為物理性去角質對皮膚嚟講可能會有少少過於刺激，做太多次有機會損害皮膚。呢款去角質凝胶用完之後會為後續護膚同化妝留低一個幾滑嘅底層。物理性去角質之後再搽護膚品同化妝，感覺舒服好多。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
